_comment: Fragment 27 — D-70, Stages A/B/C installed, Stage D recorded as blocked. Merged 2026-08-21.

nodes.label: D-70 — Stages A, B and C Installed
nodes.description: The verification apparatus is no longer specified-not-installed. Stage A created eslint.config.mjs and repointed the lint script; Stage B installed the bun test runner, a smoke test and .github/workflows/ci.yml with typecheck, lint and test as separate steps; Stage C installed C-14's detection checks at scripts/check-consistency.mjs and wired them into CI. All six R3 definition-of-done conditions are met, with CI green on a real run.
nodes.rationale: Executes the sequence D-65 set out, in its stated order, with the build guardrail lifted for these three stages only. Stage D was requested in the same pass and is recorded as blocked rather than delivered partially and counted as done.

nodes.label: D-5 — CI Was Shown to Turn Red, Not Assumed To
nodes.description: A deliberate type error was pushed, CI failed at the Typecheck step specifically, and the commit was reverted. Green, then red, then green again across three real runs.
nodes.rationale: A gate that is present but inert is exactly what TC6's ignoreBuildErrors produced for the ten type errors D-67 fixed — they sat unreported since scaffolding. Observing the gate fail is the only evidence that it is a gate rather than a step that always succeeds.

nodes.label: C-14 Is Installed in CI for Three Checks, Local for the Fourth
nodes.description: Shared-core hash, the D-54 tier sweep and the section 5.1 duplicate-ID scan run in CI. Graph coverage does not: it reads .graphify/graph.json, which is gitignored, so its input does not exist on a fresh clone. It reports SKIP with the reason, and the runner counts skips separately rather than folding them into the pass total.
nodes.rationale: Structural rather than a defect — the graph is a build artifact whose curated layer is not rebuildable from docs/, merging only from docs/graph-fragments/ under G51. Stated explicitly because a claim that detection is installed would otherwise overclaim, and because reporting three of four as 4/4 passed is the same overclaim this apparatus exists to catch.

nodes.label: The Tier Sweep Caught a Real Defect on Its First Strict Run
nodes.description: D-65 was marked propagated to the build spec and was absent from it. Commit 8b03b7a, the D-67 pass two commits earlier, had replaced the only sentence citing it. A tier claim that was true when written had silently stopped being true. The same check then caught a second error in the very pass that installed it: C-14 was marked propagated to SPECS-VERIFICATION-APPARATUS without being mentioned there.
nodes.rationale: G32, G53 and G58 were each found by a human noticing, twice by the Chief Editor challenging a completion claim — luck with a good record rather than a control. These are the first defects of that family found by a control instead.

nodes.label: A Check That Cannot Fail Is Not a Control
nodes.description: The first tier sweep accepted any ID from a row's Item cell. Deliberately breaking D-66's inventory reference did not fail it, because the row also names G62 and G62 was still present — a gap reference masking a decision that never propagated. D-54 requires the decision to be traceable, so a D-NN named in a row is now required specifically.
nodes.rationale: The same finding as D-67's invalid probe, one layer up: both passed convincingly while testing nothing. Found only because the check was deliberately broken to see whether it would notice — which is the negative test the apparatus itself now depends on.

nodes.label: Installing the Config Changed the Thing Measured
nodes.description: D-66 measured both ESLint presets at 21 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings — before eslint.config.mjs existed, so the config file was not in its own lint set. On creation it warned on itself under import/no-anonymous-default-export. Naming the exported array restored 0 warnings, now including the file itself.
nodes.rationale: The smallest correction of the pass and the most characteristic. The measurement was accurate for what it measured; the act of installing enlarged the set being measured. A prior measurement is evidence about a prior state, not a prediction about the state after the change.

nodes.label: Stage D Was Requested and Is Not Completable
nodes.description: D-17 holds the 0002 draft outside supabase/migrations/ until every S1 window decision is settled. Verified against live section 5.1 rows: Q10 open, Q11 open and deferred, G64 specified-not-applied, G16, G17, G19, G20, G42, GA1, GA3, GA4 and GA9 open, GA2 half closed, C-11 and C-12 open. No migration was written and 0001_init.sql is untouched.
nodes.rationale: Completing it would mean inventing answers to those decisions, reversing D-68 one pass after it was made, and writing an irreversible migration against a live provisioned database whose target table NFR-02 makes append-only. Stage D was never waiting on the guardrail, so lifting it for A, B and C did not unblock D.
